text:
Predicates:
Winner(x, y) ::: x is the winner of y.
Participated(x, y) ::: x participated in y.
Tie(y) ::: y is a tie.
SixWayTie(y) ::: y is a six-way tie.
FromBelgium(x) ::: x is from Belgium.
OnLeaderboard(x, y) ::: x is on the leaderboard of y.

Premises:
Winner(Steinhauer, duMaurier1992) ::: Steinhauer was the winner of the 1992 du Maurier Classic.
Participated(Steinhauer, duMaurier1992) ::: Steinhauer participated in the 1992 du Maurier Classic.
∃x (Tie(x) ∧ SixWayTie(x) ∧ ∃y (FromBelgium(y) ∧ OnLeaderboard(y, duMaurier1992) ∧ ∃z (Participant(z, duMaurier1992) ∧ z in x))) ::: There was a six-way tie on the leaderboard, and one person in the six-way tie was from Belgium, and Descampe is from Belgium and on the leaderboard.
∀x (Participant(x, duMaurier1992) → OnLeaderboard(x, duMaurier1992)) ::: All people on the leaderboard participated in the 1992 du Maurier Classic.
